sentences: Traders moved $669 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-10-19, across 17.3 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 54% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 46%.
The most-traded market was "Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?", pulling in $5 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
The usual pattern held: algorithmic traders made $183K (+148 bps on volume) while retail traders lost $4K (-42 bps).
